passages.text: Now Solomon purposed to build a house for the Name of the LORD and a royal palace for himself.
passages.sermon: Solomon was king of Israel.\r\nSolomon decided to build a house for the Name of the LORD.\r\nSolomon also decided to build a royal palace for himself.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לִבְנ֥וֹת בַּ֙יִת֙ לְשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה וּבַ֖יִת לְמַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So he conscripted 70,000 porters, 80,000 stonecutters in the mountains, and 3,600 supervisors.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
Solomon planned to build a house for the LORD.
Solomon needed many workers for this task.
Solomon counted seventy thousand men to carry burdens.
Solomon counted eighty thousand men to cut stone in the mountains.
Solomon appointed three thousand six hundred men as supervisors over the workers.
passages.original: וַיִּסְפֹּ֨ר שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ אִ֣ישׁ סַבָּ֔ל וּשְׁמוֹנִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ חֹצֵ֣ב בָּהָ֑ר וּמְנַצְּחִ֣ים עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

passages.text: Then Solomon sent word to Hiram king of Tyre: “Do for me as you did for my father David when you sent him cedars to build himself a house to live in.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was the king of Israel.
\r\nHiram was the king of Tyre.
\r\nSolomon sent a message to Hiram.
\r\nSolomon said, "You helped my father David."
\r\n"You sent cedar wood to David."
\r\n"David used the cedar wood to build a house to live in."
\r\n"Please do the same for me."
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֶל־ חוּרָ֥ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ צֹ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ עִם־ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔י וַתִּֽשְׁלַֽח־ ל֣וֹ אֲרָזִ֔ים לִבְנֽוֹת־ ל֥וֹ בַ֖יִת לָשֶׁ֥בֶת בּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Behold, I am about to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God to dedicate to Him for burning fragrant incense before Him, for displaying the showbread continuously, and for making burnt offerings every morning and evening as well as on the Sabbaths, New Moons, and appointed feasts of the LORD our God. This is ordained for Israel forever.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
Solomon spoke to Hiram, king of Tyre.
Solomon said, “I am about to build a house.
I will build this house for the Name of the LORD my God.
I will dedicate this house to the LORD.
In this house, we will burn fragrant incense before the LORD.
We will display the showbread in this house at all times.
We will offer burnt offerings in this house every morning.
We will offer burnt offerings every evening.
We will offer burnt offerings on the Sabbaths.
We will offer burnt offerings on the New Moons.
We will offer burnt offerings on the appointed feasts of the LORD our God.
The LORD has commanded Israel to do this forever.
passages.original: הִנֵּה֩ אֲנִ֨י בֽוֹנֶה־ בַּ֜יִת לְשֵׁ֣ם׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֗י לְהַקְדִּ֣ישׁ ל֡וֹ לְהַקְטִ֣יר לְפָנָ֣יו קְטֹֽרֶת־ סַמִּים֩ וּמַעֲרֶ֨כֶת תָּמִ֤יד וְעֹלוֹת֙ לַבֹּ֣קֶר וְלָעֶ֔רֶב לַשַּׁבָּתוֹת֙ וְלֶ֣חֳדָשִׁ֔ים וּֽלְמוֹעֲדֵ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לְעוֹלָ֖ם זֹ֥את עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: The house that I am building will be great, for our God is greater than all gods.
passages.sermon:
Solomon is the king of Israel.
Solomon is building a house.
This house will be great.
Our God is greater than all other gods.
That is why the house will be great.
passages.original: וְהַבַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֥י בוֹנֶ֖ה גָּד֑וֹל כִּֽי־ גָד֥וֹל אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ מִכָּל־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: But who is able to build a house for Him, since the heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain Him? Who then am I, that I should build a house for Him, except as a place to burn sacrifices before Him?
passages.sermon:
Solomon is the speaker.
Solomon is king of Israel.
Solomon wants to build a house for the LORD God.
No one has enough strength to build a house for God.
The heavens cannot contain God.
Even the highest heavens cannot contain Him.
No one can truly build a house for God.
I am not worthy to build a house for God.
I can only build a house as a place to offer sacrifices before Him.
passages.original: וּמִ֤י יַעֲצָר־ כֹּ֙חַ֙ לִבְנֽוֹת־ ל֣וֹ בַ֔יִת כִּ֧י הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם וּשְׁמֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לֹ֣א יְכַלְכְּלֻ֑הוּ וּמִ֤י אֲנִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶבְנֶה־ לּ֣וֹ בַ֔יִת כִּ֖י אִם־ לְהַקְטִ֥יר לְפָנָֽיו׃

passages.text: Send me, therefore, a craftsman skilled in engraving to work with gold and silver, with bronze and iron, and with purple, crimson, and blue yarn. He will work with my craftsmen in Judah and Jerusalem, whom my father David provided.
passages.sermon:
Solomon is the king of Israel.
Solomon is building a great temple for God.
Solomon asks for help from Hiram, king of Tyre.
Solomon says, "Send me a skilled craftsman."
The craftsman must know how to work with gold.
He must know how to work with silver.
He must know how to work with bronze.
He must know how to work with iron.
He must know how to work with purple yarn.
He must know how to work with crimson yarn.
He must know how to work with blue yarn.
He must know how to engrave designs.
He will work together with my craftsmen.
My craftsmen are in Judah and Jerusalem.
My father David provided these craftsmen.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה שְֽׁלַֽח־ לִ֣י אִישׁ־ חָכָ֡ם לַעֲשׂוֹת֩ בַּזָּהָ֨ב וּבַכֶּ֜סֶף וּבַנְּחֹ֣שֶׁת וּבַבַּרְזֶ֗ל וּבָֽאַרְגְּוָן֙ וְכַרְמִ֣יל וּתְכֵ֔לֶת וְיֹדֵ֖עַ לְפַתֵּ֣חַ פִּתּוּחִ֑ים עִם־ הַֽחֲכָמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר עִמִּי֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֣ה וּבִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵכִ֖ין דָּוִ֥יד אָבִֽי׃

passages.text: Send me also cedar, cypress, and algum logs from Lebanon, for I know that your servants have skill to cut timber there. And indeed, my servants will work with yours to prepare for me timber in abundance, because the temple I am building will be great and wonderful.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was the king of Israel.
He wanted to build a great and wonderful temple for the LORD.
He spoke to Hiram, king of Tyre.
Solomon said, "Send me cedar logs from Lebanon."
He said, "Send me cypress logs from Lebanon."
He said, "Send me algum logs from Lebanon."
Solomon knew that Hiram’s servants had skill to cut timber in Lebanon.
He said, "Your servants know how to cut the trees."
He said, "My servants will work together with your servants."
He said, "They will prepare much timber for me."
He said, "I need much wood."
He said, "The house I am building will be large and wonderful."
passages.original: וּֽשְׁלַֽח־ לִי֩ עֲצֵ֨י אֲרָזִ֜ים בְּרוֹשִׁ֣ים וְאַלְגּוּמִּים֮ מֵֽהַלְּבָנוֹן֒ כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יָדַ֔עְתִּי אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ יֽוֹדְעִ֔ים לִכְר֖וֹת עֲצֵ֣י לְבָנ֑וֹן וְהִנֵּ֥ה עֲבָדַ֖י עִם־ עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃ וּלְהָכִ֥ין לִ֛י עֵצִ֖ים לָרֹ֑ב כִּ֥י הַבַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֥י בוֹנֶ֖ה גָּד֥וֹל וְהַפְלֵֽא׃

passages.text: I will pay your servants, the woodcutters, 20,000 cors of ground wheat, 20,000 cors of barley, 20,000 baths of wine, and 20,000 baths of olive oil.”
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
He needed wood for building the temple.
He asked for help from the king of Tyre.
He promised to pay the woodcutters.
I will give your servants wheat.
I will give them 20,000 cors of ground wheat.
I will give them barley.
I will give them 20,000 cors of barley.
I will give them wine.
I will give them 20,000 baths of wine.
I will give them olive oil.
I will give them 20,000 baths of olive oil.
passages.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה לַֽחֹטְבִ֣ים׀ לְֽכֹרְתֵ֣י׀ הָעֵצִ֡ים נָתַתִּי֩ חִטִּ֨ים׀ מַכּ֜וֹת לַעֲבָדֶ֗יךָ כֹּרִים֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׂעֹרִ֕ים כֹּרִ֖ים עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אָ֑לֶף וְיַ֗יִן בַּתִּים֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וְשֶׁ֕מֶן בַּתִּ֖ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אָֽלֶף׃פ

passages.text: Then Hiram king of Tyre wrote a letter in reply to Solomon: “Because the LORD loves His people, He has set you over them as king.”
passages.sermon:
Hiram was the king of Tyre.
Hiram wrote a letter to Solomon.
Hiram sent this letter to Solomon.
Hiram said, “The LORD loves His people.
Because the LORD loves His people, He made you their king.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר חוּרָ֤ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ צֹר֙ בִּכְתָ֔ב וַיִּשְׁלַ֖ח אֶל־ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בְּאַהֲבַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ עַמּ֔וֹ נְתָנְךָ֥ עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: And Hiram added: “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who made the heavens and the earth! He has given King David a wise son with insight and understanding, who will build a temple for the LORD and a royal palace for himself.
passages.sermon:
Hiram was the king of Tyre.
Hiram spoke these words.
Hiram said, “Blessed be the LORD.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD made the heavens.
The LORD made the earth.
The LORD gave King David a son.
This son is wise.
This son has insight.
This son has understanding.
This son will build a temple for the LORD.
This son will build a royal palace for himself.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ חוּרָם֒ בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַן֩ לְדָוִ֨יד הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ בֵּ֣ן חָכָ֗ם יוֹדֵ֙עַ֙ שֵׂ֣כֶל וּבִינָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִבְנֶה־ בַּ֙יִת֙ לַיהוָ֔ה וּבַ֖יִת לְמַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So now I am sending you Huram-abi, a skillful man endowed with creativity.
passages.sermon:
Hiram is the king of Tyre.
Hiram wrote a letter to Solomon.
Hiram said, “Now I am sending you a man.”
This man is named Huram-abi.
Huram-abi is skillful.
Huram-abi has understanding.
Huram-abi has wisdom.
Huram-abi is creative.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה שָׁלַ֧חְתִּי אִישׁ־ חָכָ֛ם יוֹדֵ֥עַ בִּינָ֖ה לְחוּרָ֥ם אָבִֽי׃

passages.text: He is the son of a woman from the daughters of Dan, and his father is a man of Tyre. He is skilled in work with gold and silver, bronze and iron, stone and wood, purple, blue, and crimson yarn, and fine linen. He is experienced in every kind of engraving and can execute any design that is given him. He will work with your craftsmen and with those of my lord, your father David.
passages.sermon:
Huram-abi is a craftsman.
His mother is a woman from the tribe of Dan.
His father is a man from Tyre.
Huram-abi knows how to work with gold.
He knows how to work with silver.
He knows how to work with bronze.
He knows how to work with iron.
He knows how to work with stone.
He knows how to work with wood.
He knows how to work with purple yarn.
He knows how to work with blue yarn.
He knows how to work with fine linen.
He knows how to work with crimson yarn.
He is skilled in every kind of engraving.
He can make any design that is given to him.
He will work with your craftsmen.
He will work with the craftsmen of my lord David, your father.
passages.original: בֶּן־ אִשָּׁ֞ה מִן־ בְּנ֣וֹת דָּ֗ן וְאָבִ֣יו אִישׁ־ צֹרִ֡י יוֹדֵ֡עַ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת בַּזָּֽהָב־ וּ֠בַכֶּסֶף בַּנְּחֹ֨שֶׁת בַּבַּרְזֶ֜ל בָּאֲבָנִ֣ים וּבָעֵצִ֗ים בָּאַרְגָּמָ֤ן בַּתְּכֵ֙לֶת֙ וּבַבּ֣וּץ וּבַכַּרְמִ֔יל וּלְפַתֵּ֙חַ֙ כָּל־ פִּתּ֔וּחַ וְלַחְשֹׁ֖ב כָּל־ מַחֲשָׁ֑בֶת אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִנָּֽתֶן־ לוֹ֙ עִם־ חֲכָמֶ֔יךָ וְֽחַכְמֵ֔י אֲדֹנִ֖י דָּוִ֥יד אָבִֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Now let my lord send to his servants the wheat, barley, olive oil, and wine he promised.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon spoke to Hiram, king of Tyre.
Solomon asked Hiram to send supplies.
Solomon said, “My lord, please send wheat to your servants.
Please send barley to your servants.
Please send olive oil to your servants.
Please send wine to your servants.
You promised to send these things.”
passages.original: וְ֠עַתָּה הַחִטִּ֨ים וְהַשְּׂעֹרִ֜ים הַשֶּׁ֤מֶן וְהַיַּ֙יִן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנִ֔י יִשְׁלַ֖ח לַעֲבָדָֽיו׃

passages.text: We will cut logs from Lebanon, as many as you need, and we will float them to you as rafts by sea down to Joppa. Then you can take them up to Jerusalem.”
passages.sermon:
We will cut logs from the forests of Lebanon.
We will cut as many logs as you need.
We will tie the logs together as rafts.
We will float the rafts by sea to the port of Joppa.
You will take the logs from Joppa up to Jerusalem.
passages.original: וַ֠אֲנַחְנוּ נִכְרֹ֨ת עֵצִ֤ים מִן־ הַלְּבָנוֹן֙ כְּכָל־ צָרְכֶּ֔ךָ וּנְבִיאֵ֥ם לְךָ֛ רַפְסֹד֖וֹת עַל־ יָ֣ם יָפ֑וֹ וְאַתָּ֛ה תַּעֲלֶ֥ה אֹתָ֖ם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ

passages.text: Solomon numbered all the foreign men in the land of Israel following the census his father David had conducted, and there were found to be 153,600 in all.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
He counted all the foreign men living in the land of Israel.
He did this after the census that his father David had made.
He found 153,600 foreign men in total.
passages.original: וַיִּסְפֹּ֣ר שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה כָּל־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֤ים הַגֵּירִים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַחֲרֵ֣י הַסְּפָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְפָרָ֖ם דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑יו וַיִּמָּצְא֗וּ מֵאָ֤ה וַחֲמִשִּׁים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Solomon made 70,000 of them porters, 80,000 stonecutters in the mountains, and 3,600 supervisors.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
He counted all the foreign men in the land.
He chose some of these men for work.
He made 70,000 men into porters.
He made 80,000 men into stonecutters in the mountains.
He appointed 3,600 men as supervisors over the workers.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ מֵהֶ֜ם שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ סַבָּ֔ל וּשְׁמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף חֹצֵ֣ב בָּהָ֑ר וּשְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת מְנַצְּחִ֖ים לְהַעֲבִ֥יד אֶת־ הָעָֽם׃
